axioms.subject: DisasterInsight
axioms.evidence: We introduce DisasterInsight, a multimodal benchmark designed to evaluate vision–language models (VLMs) on realistic disaster analysis tasks.

axioms.subject: BuildingFunctionClassification
axioms.evidence: realistic disaster analysis tasks. DisasterInsight restructures the xBD dataset into approximately 112K building-centered instances and supports instruction-diverse evaluation across multiple tasks, including building-function classification

axioms.subject: DamageLevelClassification
axioms.evidence: realistic disaster analysis tasks. DisasterInsight restructures the xBD dataset into approximately 112K building-centered instances and supports instruction-diverse evaluation across multiple tasks, including building-function classification, damage-level and disaster-type classification

axioms.subject: DisasterTypeClassification
axioms.evidence: realistic disaster analysis tasks. axioms.subject: StructuredReportGeneration
axioms.evidence: realistic disaster analysis tasks. DisasterInsight restructures the xBD dataset into approximately 112K building-centered instances and supports instruction-diverse evaluation across multiple tasks, including building-function classification, damage-level and disaster-type classification, counting, and structured report generation
